description: This file defines an interface called ITokenClaimsService within the Microsoft.eShopWeb.ApplicationCore.Interfaces namespace. The interface declares a single asynchronous method GetTokenAsync that takes a username and returns a token string.

classes.name: ITokenClaimsService
classes.description: An interface for a service that provides token claims, with a method to retrieve a token asynchronously for a given user.

methods.name: GetTokenAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a token string for the specified username.
